_comments: bizapps-tasks' first row-level security filters (the meetings plan, § 4): a Standard meeting is readable by anyone who reads meetings; a Private one only by its attendees, the organizer included, found by the attendee's UserID. Parenthesised so each ANDs onto any other filter the caller holds; TRY_CAST so a missing user id matches nothing.
Pushed before the entities folder, which references them: MemberJunction refuses a change to a filter with a subquery once a permission names it.

PostgreSQL PlatformVariants are included on each filter for schema parity; runtime RLS evaluation for UI-role users requires SQL Server until MemberJunction Core wires GetPlatformFilterText into MarkupFilterText.

fields.Name: Tasks: Visible Meetings
fields.Description: A Standard meeting, or a Private meeting the caller is an attendee of.
fields.FilterText: (Visibility = N'Standard' OR ID IN (SELECT MeetingID FROM [__mj_BizAppsTasks].[vwMeetingAttendees] WHERE UserID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)))

fields.Name: Tasks: Rows Of Visible Meetings
fields.Description: A row (an attendee, an agenda item, a note) of a meeting the caller may see: Standard, or Private with the caller among its attendees.
fields.FilterText: (MeetingID IN (SELECT ID FROM [__mj_BizAppsTasks].[vwMeetings] WHERE Visibility = N'Standard' OR ID IN (SELECT MeetingID FROM [__mj_BizAppsTasks].[vwMeetingAttendees] WHERE UserID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER))))
fields.PlatformVariants: {"FilterText":{"postgresql":"(\"MeetingID\" IN (SELECT \"ID\" FROM __mj_BizAppsTasks.\"vwMeetings\" WHERE \"Visibility\" = 'Standard' OR \"ID\" IN (SELECT \"MeetingID\" FROM __mj_BizAppsTasks.\"vwMeetingAttendees\" WHERE \"UserID\" = NULLIF('{{UserID}}', '')::uuid)))"}}

fields.Name: Tasks: Visible Meeting Links
fields.Description: A link of a series the caller may see, or of a meeting the caller may see.

fields.Name: Tasks: Visible Meeting Series
fields.Description: A Standard series, or a Private series the caller organizes (through their user's link to a Person, or the Person's deprecated LinkedUserID) or is invited to.
fields.FilterText: (Visibility = N'Standard' OR OrganizerPersonID IN (SELECT TRY_CAST(LinkedEntityRecordID AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) FROM [__mj].[vwUsers] WHERE ID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)) OR OrganizerPersonID IN (SELECT ID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCommon].[vwPeople] WHERE LinkedUserID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)) OR ID IN (SELECT SeriesID FROM [__mj_BizAppsTasks].[vwMeetingSeriesAttendees] WHERE UserID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)))

fields.Name: Tasks: Rows Of Visible Tasks
fields.Description: A row (assignment, check-in, comment, or activity) of a task the caller may see: Standard, or Private where the caller is creator, assignee (Person/Role/User), or creator/assignee of its RootParentID.
fields.FilterText: (TaskID IN (SELECT t.ID FROM [__mj_BizAppsTasks].[vwTasks] t WHERE t.Visibility = N'Standard' OR t.CreatedByPersonID IN (SELECT TRY_CAST(LinkedEntityRecordID AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) FROM [__mj].[vwUsers] WHERE ID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)) OR t.CreatedByPersonID IN (SELECT ID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCommon].[vwPeople] WHERE LinkedUserID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [__mj_BizAppsTasks].[vwTaskAssignments] a WHERE (a.TaskID = t.ID OR (t.RootParentID IS NOT NULL AND a.TaskID = t.RootParentID)) AND ((a.AssigneeEntity = N'MJ_BizApps_Common: People' AND (TRY_CAST(a.AssigneeRecordID AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) IN (SELECT TRY_CAST(LinkedEntityRecordID AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) FROM [__mj].[vwUsers] WHERE ID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)) OR TRY_CAST(a.AssigneeRecordID AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) IN (SELECT ID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCommon].[vwPeople] WHERE LinkedUserID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)))) OR (a.AssigneeEntity = N'MJ: Roles' AND TRY_CAST(a.AssigneeRecordID AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) IN (SELECT RoleID FROM [__mj].[vwUserRoles] WHERE UserID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER))) OR (a.AssigneeEntity = N'MJ: Users' AND TRY_CAST(a.AssigneeRecordID AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)))) OR (t.RootParentID IS NOT NULL AND t.RootParentID IN (SELECT rp.ID FROM [__mj_BizAppsTasks].[vwTasks] rp WHERE rp.CreatedByPersonID IN (SELECT TRY_CAST(LinkedEntityRecordID AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) FROM [__mj].[vwUsers] WHERE ID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)) OR rp.CreatedByPersonID IN (SELECT ID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCommon].[vwPeople] WHERE LinkedUserID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER))))))
